title: The Witch Doctor's Broom
description: This mod will add a new structure that will generate in the swamp.
body:
The Witch Doctor's Broom adds a brand new structure that generates naturally in Swamp biomes. Hidden among the murky waters and twisted trees, you'll find the Witch Doctor's Hut — a mysterious and dangerous place that holds a powerful secret.
Inside the hut, a new boss awaits: the Witch Doctor. This formidable enemy is no ordinary witch — he will aggressively defend his domain using dark magic. Prepare yourself before engaging, as the fight is not easy.
Upon defeating the Witch Doctor, he will drop his most prized possession: the Flying Broom. This unique item allows the player to mount and fly through the world, consuming experience points as fuel. The longer you fly, the more XP it costs — so keep leveling up if you want to stay airborne!
Features:

New swamp structure: the Witch Doctor's Hut
New boss: the Witch Doctor with unique combat behavior
New rideable item: the Flying Broom
Flying costs XP — adds a risk/reward mechanic to exploration
Fully compatible with Forge 1.20.1
